data.objective: A premium sushi dining experience focused on fresh ingredients, handcrafted sushi and precise Japanese preparation.

data.rootCause: The render is visually strong at the start, but the actual cut is not the plan: it includes a completely different sequence with unplanned diner footage, dead black frames, and a final CTA that arrives late and weakly. The biggest failure is execution mismatch versus the executable timeline—missing the intended structured 8-beat sushi story, missing finished audio/text execution consistency, and losing premium continuity through repeated and off-brand visuals.

issues.problem: The render abruptly shifts into unrelated customer-eating footage that is not part of the planned premium sushi prep story.
issues.fix: Remove the diner reaction shots entirely and keep the cut focused on chef craft, plating, and hero plate moments only.

issues.problem: There is a long black/dropped section before the final CTA, which kills momentum and makes the reel feel broken.
issues.fix: Replace the dead air with a clean hero hold or earlier CTA lock-up so the last 2 seconds are fully active.

issues.problem: The on-screen copy is partially blurred/soft and not consistently integrated across shots; later text delivery is weak or missing.
issues.fix: Use one or two short, sharp text beats only, with safe placement and consistent styling; make the CTA fully readable on the hero plate.

issues.problem: No visible brand identity, signage, or logo appears, so the reel feels generic and unowned.
issues.fix: Use the final CTA as a brand lock-up and keep any brand name on screen longer over the cleanest hero frame.

issues.problem: The edit repeats similar close-up food action and then abandons the sushi-prep narrative for diner B-roll, reducing visual coherence.
issues.fix: Trim repetition and build a tighter progression: reveal, ingredient, knife, plating, hero.

issues.problem: The render does not feel like a finished commercial mix; the executable music/SFX intent is not visibly supported by the frames, and the edit reads silent/unfinished.
issues.fix: Add a polished premium music bed with deliberate accents at reveal, slice, and CTA, and ensure the audible mix matches the cut energy.
